findings.location: Scope; Increment B step 1; Increment C step 1
findings.problem: The plan requires every owner change to be duplicated to a user-level “mirror,” but its stated roadmap direction says the earlier repositories will go away and “there is no mirror to keep in step.” The inventory also records this as F-C5. The plan neither establishes a temporary exception nor bounds when mirror synchronization ends.
findings.suggestion: Remove the mirror requirement, or explicitly document the transitional reason, the mirror’s retirement condition, and how the plan remains consistent with the roadmap.

findings.problem: The plan calls `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests` the “whole suite,” but `docs/development.md` defines the full test command as `python3 -B -W error tests/run_all.py`, which also runs package tests.
findings.suggestion: Use the documented full-test command when claiming a whole-suite run, or call the narrower command a repository-test run and justify why it is sufficient.

summary: The plan aligns with the inventory’s M8/M9 gates, but its ongoing mirror-update requirement drifts from the roadmap’s no-mirror direction.
